Yes, it is flat twelve on the third floor.

The whole flat is cold.

Yes, the water is fine.
Would daytime access be possible?
Yes, I work from home.
Has anything changed about who looks after the building?
Worth knowing: the building changed managing agents at the start of the quarter.
Have you checked the thermostat setting?
Yes, it is turned right up.
Would you like a text before anyone arrives?
Yes, a text would help.
Is the number ending in nine-zero-six still right?
Yes, that is my number.
Is there a boiler cupboard inside the flat?
Yes, in the hallway.
Are neighbours reporting the same problem?
One of them mentioned it too.
Is there a buzzer at the main entrance?
Yes, there is one.
I will Move the tenant elsewhere before any visit is attempted.
Okay, I will wait for someone to come.
I came back after thirty-five minutes and no job appears to have been raised at all.
I will Post out portable heaters instead.
